from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityData(BaseModel):
    """One university's enrollment and class size data from a CDS report."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university")
    academic_term: str | None = Field(description="The term/year the data represents (e.g., Fall 2021)")
    undergraduate_enrollment: int | None = Field(description="Total undergraduate enrollment count")
    large_class_sections_count: int | None = Field(description="Number of undergraduate class sections with 100 or more students")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_data: list[UniversityData]
